sloka: प्रमुमोद च लोकः तम् नृपम् आसाद्य राघव ।नष्टशोकः समृद्धार्थो बभूव विगतज्वरः ॥१-४४-१९॥
transliteration: pramumoda ca lokaḥ tam nṛpam āsādya rāghava ।naṣṭaśokaḥ samṛddhārtho babhūva vigatajvaraḥ ॥1-44-19॥

translations.english: "O Best of the Raghus the world rejoiced having Bhagiratha as king. With his purpose achieved, he was freed from all mental afflictions and sorrows and thereafter lived happily.
